svg.desc: Two panels for the same people on two networks: 96 naive agents who start with a view of 100, a fanatic at 500 and a rational agent at 300, who never change their views. On the symmetric network each naive agent keeps 50% on her own view, spreads 10% evenly over the other naive agents and puts 20% on the fanatic and 20% on the rational agent. On the layered network one influencer listens to the fanatic, 5 sub-influencers listen to her and 90 followers each listen to one sub-influencer, each naive agent keeping 50% on her own view, 45% on the layer above and 5% on the rational agent. Top, the average naive view by round, with its long-run value dashed, 400 on the symmetric network and 447.0 on the layered one; dots mark the first round past half-way, round 2 at 292.0 and round 5 at 295.5. Bottom, the change of the average in each round: on the symmetric network 120, 72, 43.2, ..., each 0.6 times the one before, so the average slows from the first round; on the layered network 11.9, 14.6, 47.7, 62.1, 59.2, ..., largest in round 4, an S-shaped path from relay delay alone. The networks and views are this book's choice, the two readings are this book's derivation, and every number is this book's calculation.
